passive.name: Blinky
passive.description: Shizuku's vacuum, Blinky, can swallow anything that is not alive. Periodically, her next basic attack destroys an enemy ward, trap or mine in a single hit. Her basic attacks also deal bonus damage to lifeless summons.

swallow.effect: Destroyed by a single basic attack
swallow.cooldown: 60s at level 1, down to 30s at level 20

effects.lifelessSummons: Take 200% damage from her basic attacks

h1.name: Vacuum Smash
h1.description: Shizuku's next basic attack swings Blinky in a heavy blow that knocks the target up.

h2.name: Blood Drain
h2.description: Blinky latches onto a nearby wounded enemy and sucks the blood from their wounds for 2 seconds, dealing damage over time and healing Shizuku. Blinky cannot swallow the living, only the blood they have already lost, so it only works on enemies who are hurt. The drain breaks if the target gets too far away.

condition.wounded: Below 70% health, or hit by Shizuku in the last 3s

h3.name: Clean Up
h3.description: Shizuku runs Blinky over an ally or herself, sucking away harmful effects such as poisons, burns and slows, and grants a small shield.

cleanse.removes: Slows, roots and damage over time (poison, burn, bleed)

h4.name: Total Suction
h4.description: Shizuku plants her feet and channels Blinky in a wide cone in front of her. Everything non-living in the cone is swallowed: enemy projectiles, zones, traps and wards, so allies behind her are shielded from incoming shots. Living enemies cannot be swallowed, so they are dragged towards her instead.

swallow.targets: Enemy projectiles, zones, traps and wards inside the cone
swallow.projectiles: Every enemy projectile that enters the cone is absorbed, protecting Shizuku and the allies behind her

pull.speed: 150 units per second toward Shizuku (about 375 in total)

lore:
Shizuku Murasaki was born in Meteor City, a vast junkyard of outcasts whose people exist in no official record, and that makes her almost impossible to trace. She joined the Phantom Troupe as its eighth member, replacing the one who held the number before her, and soon became one of its most dependable killers. During the Yorknew City auction raid she cut down mafia bodyguards with single swings and erased every trace of the massacre, and in the Chimera Ant crisis she defeated an Officer on her own. Calm to the point of seeming soulless, she is fiercely loyal to the Spiders and believes in Chrollo's rules above everything else.

Shizuku's Nen ability, Blinky, is a conjured vacuum cleaner with a single rule: it can swallow anything except living things, which makes it the perfect tool for wiping out evidence, and in a fight it can even drain an enemy's blood straight from his wounds. She swings it as a weapon with frightening speed and strength. Blunt, air-headed and so forgetful that she sometimes forgets people she has already met, she is easy to underestimate, which is exactly what makes her dangerous.
